questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a free-living microbe?
questions.solution: Amoeba is a free-living microbe because it can survive and reproduce independently in its environment. Plasmodium vivax and Entamoeba histolytica are parasitic organisms that require a host to complete their life cycles. Tomato Wilt Virus is not a living microbe but a virus, which cannot reproduce on its own.

hi.stem: निम्न में से कौन एक स्वतंत्र रूप से रहने वाला सूक्ष्मजीव है?
hi.solution: अमीबा एक स्वतंत्र रूप से रहने वाला सूक्ष्मजीव है क्योंकि यह अपने वातावरण में स्वतंत्र रूप से जीवित रह सकता है और प्रजनन कर सकता है। प्लाज्मोडियम विवैक्स और एंटैमीबा हिस्टोलिटिका परजीवी सूक्ष्मजीव हैं जिन्हें अपने जीवन चक्र को पूरा करने के लिए मेजबान की आवश्यकता होती है। टमाटर विल्ट वायरस एक जीवित सूक्ष्मजीव नहीं है बल्कि एक वायरस है, जो अकेले प्रजनन नहीं कर सकता।

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a unicellular eukaryotic organism?
questions.solution: Amoeba is a unicellular eukaryotic organism because it has a nucleus and other membrane-bound organelles. Bacteria and cyanobacteria lack a nucleus and are classified as prokaryotes. Viruses are not considered living organisms and do not have cellular structures.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of fungi?
choices: They absorb food from decaying organic matter
questions.solution: Fungi absorb food from decaying organic matter, which is a key feature of their nutrition method. They are not autotrophic because they cannot produce their own food, they do not reproduce only by budding as some use spores, and not all fungi are multicellular since some are unicellular.

questions.stem: A student observed an organism that had chloroplasts and lived in water. Which group does this organism most likely belong to?
questions.solution: Algae are aquatic, eukaryotic organisms that contain chloroplasts and perform photosynthesis. Fungi are not capable of photosynthesis and are heterotrophic. questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about viruses?

questions.stem: A researcher found a microorganism that can only reproduce inside a host cell. It contains DNA or RNA and is surrounded by a protein coat. Which of the following is this microorganism most likely to be?
questions.solution: A bacteriophage is a type of virus that requires a host cell to reproduce and has a protein coat surrounding its genetic material, which matches the description. Algae are self-feeding organisms that do not require a host for reproduction. Fungi obtain nutrients from their environment and do not reproduce inside host cells. Amoebae are independent, single-celled organisms that do not rely on a host for reproduction.
